channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 1
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 1 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 1: The schedule note for Block 1 still quoted the City's…
item.description: The schedule note for Block 1 still quoted the City's earlier listing (final action October 6, 2026, status 'Mayors Office'). The Legistar page now lists the agreement as passed, final action and enactment October 13, 2026 (Enactment No. 208-26), and the note says so. Both ordinances say 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a) and File 260724, in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment), which makes November 13, 2026 the effective date by our count, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text; the heights and uses in the enacted text are not yet checked against this record. Source: SF Board of Supervisors, Legistar, BOS File 260724 and File 260770 (https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127453&GUID=CC4AC1DD-BF51-4585-86E8-0A5D44AA3745); Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachments: https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063745&GUID=68B0CE5F-84C2-4368-BF8D-EEA7D8B92E55 and https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063746&GUID=9EA91A49-BBF9-4471-9EA9-6E7BD33A4353.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 1: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026…
item.description: The Board's ordinance as enacted on October 13, 2026 sets new height limits for Block 1: 188 ft over a 120 ft base on the west part and 120 ft on the east part. They take effect 31 days after enactment, November 13, 2026 by our count; until then the earlier limits (180 ft over 85 ft, and 85 ft) apply. Source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, p. 29 (Figure 249.87-2 'Building Heights Maximum') and p. 56 (§5(a): 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment'); Legistar: Final action and Enactment date 10/13/2026, Enactment # 209-26. File 260724 attachment p. 10: 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment.'.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 1: The City's Legistar pages for the amended development…
item.description: The City's Legistar pages for the amended development agreement (File 260724) and its zoning ordinance (File 260770) list both as passed and enacted on October 13, 2026 (Mayor approved; enactment numbers 208-26 and 209-26). This record had said enactment was not confirmed. The final text and the date the ordinances take effect were not read, so the record's height and use figures still show the adopted limits. Source: SF Board of Supervisors, Legistar, BOS File 260724 and File 260770 (https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127453&GUID=CC4AC1DD-BF51-4585-86E8-0A5D44AA3745).

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 1: Completion expected: Block 1 is in Phase 2 of… (~2031)
item.description: Completion expected: Block 1 is in Phase 2 of the October 2020 re-phased program; SocketSite's block-by-block schedule for that program shows vertical development on Block 1 from 2029 to 2031; a 2020 forecast that the 2026 Phasing Plan amendments (see below) may have superseded (~2031). Source: SF Planning, 2020-10-07; SocketSite, 2020-10-09; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-10-13; SF Board of Supervisors (Legistar), 2026-09-28.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 1: Block 1's page now says the block lies entirely inside…
item.description: Block 1's page now says the block lies entirely inside active Assessor lot 4175500 (1248 Georgia Ln, added October 15, 2024), a larger lot that is not Block 1's own, and no longer describes the ground condition. The 2018 draft EIR's reference to Assessor lot 4175018 is presented as 2018 ownership; DataSF now lists that lot as retired. Source: DataSF Parcels, blklot 4175500 (data.sf.gov/resource/acdm-wktn.json?blklot=4175500); Potrero Power Station Draft EIR Vol. 1, Oct 2018 (sfmea.sfplanning.org/2017-011878ENV_DEIR_Volume_1.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 1: Block 1's heights now follow the colour-coded labels…
item.description: Block 1's heights now follow the colour-coded labels on the Design for Development's Figure 6.2.3 (180 ft maximum with an 85 ft base on the west part, 85 ft on the east part); the earlier '115 ft' was a plan-dimension line, not a height. The expected completion changed from the 2035 whole-project date to 2031: the October 2020 Phase 1 approval places Block 1 in Phase 2 and SocketSite's schedule table shows vertical development 2029-2031 (a 2020 forecast). The earlier statement that no source supports a Public Library option here was removed: the Phase 1 approval moves that option to Block 1. The dead August 2019 draft Design for Development link was replaced with the final February 2020 document, the land-use figure is now tagged as a document rather than a rendering, and publisher names on source entries were corrected. Source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 Development Phase Approval, 2020-10-07 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html).
item.source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 Development Phase Approval, 2020-10-07 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html)

item.title: Planned · Potrero Power Station Block 1: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero… (Apr 21, 2020)
item.description: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement covering the adopted Design for Development, whose Land Use Table (Table 3.1.1) lists Block 1 as a development block; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date (Apr 21, 2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-11-14; SF Planning; SF Planning (document adopted by the Planning Commission; the D4D names no publisher), 2020-02-26.
